name: Tortue moussue
desc: an old sturdy tortoise whose thick shell is covered in moss, ferns and tiny flowers, wise sleepy eyes, wrinkled beak

name: Grisdent
desc: Grisdent, an enormous grey-furred forest bear-wolf beast with one huge chipped grey stone tooth jutting from its jaw, glowing amber eyes, bark and lichen tangled in its mane, imposing and menacing

name: Reine Gelée
desc: a giant regal queen slime made of translucent blue-green jelly, a small golden crown floating inside her wobbling body, haughty half-lidded eyes, smaller slime droplets orbiting her

name: Grande Luciole
desc: a colossal ancient firefly queen with a blazing golden-orange glowing abdomen, elegant antennae shaped like a crown, shimmering wings, swarms of tiny fireflies circling her

name: Corbeau-Liche
desc: an undead lich crow, a huge black raven with a skull-like bone beak, tattered feathers, glowing pale green ghostly eyes, a small crown of twisted bones, wisps of green necrotic mist

name: Capitaine Balafre
desc: a swaggering bandit captain with a huge diagonal scar across his face, eyepatch, wide feathered tricorn hat, braided red beard, a curved sabre over his shoulder, embers in the air

name: Vipère des joncs
desc: a slender emerald-and-teal reed viper coiled among marsh reeds, slit golden eyes, dripping venom from its fangs

name: Moustique géant
desc: a giant gangly swamp mosquito with a needle-like proboscis, bulging red eyes, translucent veined wings, thin striped legs

name: Noyé
desc: a drowned zombie sailor, bloated blue-grey skin, seaweed tangled in his hair, barnacles on his shoulder, empty glowing eyes, water dripping

name: Feu-follet
desc: a will-o'-the-wisp, a floating ball of soft orange-blue flame with a small mischievous face, trailing flickering tendrils of light

name: Caïman
desc: a big swamp caiman rising from murky water, armored scaly snout, toothy grin, cold yellow eyes, duckweed on its head

name: Sangsue
desc: a fat slimy giant leech with a round circular mouth full of tiny teeth, dark brown glistening segmented body, curled menacingly

name: Sorcière des joncs
desc: a hunched reed witch with a wide crooked hat woven from rushes, long nose, green-tinged skin, holding a smoking little cauldron ladle, candle-flame eyes. Original character

name: Papillon de nuit
desc: a large dusky moth with fuzzy body, feathery antennae, eye-spot patterns on its soft grey-violet wings, glittering dust falling

name: Héron pêcheur
desc: a tall grey fishing heron with a long dagger-like beak holding a wriggling fish, sharp stare, elegant plumes

name: Racine animée
desc: an animated tangle of gnarled tree roots shaped like a hunched creature, knotty face with glowing moss-green eyes, soil clumps falling

name: Hydre de vase
desc: a three-headed mud hydra rising from a swamp, slick dark green scales covered in sludge, three snarling heads with glowing eyes, mud dripping

name: Saule gémissant
desc: a weeping willow tree spirit with a sorrowful wailing face in its trunk, long drooping branches like hair, hollow glowing eyes, tears of sap

name: Chaudronnière
desc: a formidable swamp hag cook stirring a huge bubbling cauldron with green-orange fumes, wild grey hair, ladle like a sceptre, toad on her shoulder. Original character

name: Bourgmestre noyé
desc: a drowned ghostly town mayor in a soaked old-fashioned coat with a tarnished chain of office, seaweed beard, top hat, pale blue glowing eyes

name: Grand Héron
desc: a gigantic majestic ancient heron with storm-grey plumage, crest of long plumes like a crown, piercing eyes, wind swirling around its wings

name: Mère des Marais
desc: the Mother of the Marsh, a towering swamp goddess made of water lilies, mud and reeds, serene but frightening face, glowing blue eyes, fireflies around her

name: Squelette
desc: a grinning skeleton warrior with a dented rusty helmet and a notched sword, cracked bones, faint glow in the eye sockets

name: Spectre
desc: a floating hooded spectre with a translucent pale green tattered shroud, dark hollow face with two glowing eyes, ghostly hands

name: Chauve-souris de suie
desc: a soot-black bat with ember-red eyes, smoky wings shedding ash particles, sharp tiny fangs

name: Élémentaire de braise
desc: an ember elemental, a humanoid form of glowing coals and cracked charcoal with flames bursting from its head and fists

name: Golem d'obsidienne
desc: a heavy obsidian golem with glossy black volcanic glass body, sharp facets, magma glowing in the cracks, small bright eyes

name: Scorpion de lave
desc: a lava scorpion with a black rocky carapace, molten orange veins, a dripping magma stinger raised high

name: Araignée de cendre
desc: an ash-grey spider with eight glowing blue eyes, dusty hairy legs, frosty blue web strands

name: Soldat de cendre
desc: a soldier made of ash and cinders in a scorched helmet and charred armor, burning eyes, flaking embers falling from him

name: Liche apprentie
desc: a young apprentice lich, a skeletal mage in oversized dark blue robes, holding a glowing blue spellbook, a little hesitant

name: Molosse d'os
desc: a bone hound, a skeletal mastiff dog with exposed ribs, spiked collar, glowing eyes, snarling jaws

name: Sentinelle de fer
desc: a towering iron sentinel automaton with riveted plates, a great tower shield and a halberd, a single glowing slit visor

name: Forgeron maudit
desc: a cursed blacksmith giant with a horned helmet, soot-blackened skin, glowing runes on his arms, a huge burning hammer resting on his shoulder

name: Liche ancienne
desc: an ancient lich king with a cracked skull face, elaborate dark crown, flowing tattered blue robes, holding a staff with an icy blue soul gem

name: Reine-Araignée
desc: a gigantic spider queen with a jeweled carapace, a crown of crystal spikes, eight glowing blue eyes, silk veil, regal and terrifying

name: Roi déchu
desc: a fallen undead king on a broken throne, rusted crown askew, tattered royal cape, gaunt pale face, ghostly green winds around him

name: Dragon de cendre
desc: an ash dragon with charcoal-grey scales cracked with glowing embers, great horns, smoke pouring from its jaws, burning eyes

name: Loup blanc
desc: a fierce white wolf with frost-dusted fur, icy blue eyes, bared fangs, snow swirling around

name: Yéti
desc: a hulking shaggy yeti with thick white fur, broad grumpy face, small horns, frost on its eyebrows

name: Ours des neiges
desc: a massive snow bear with thick cream-white fur, scarred muzzle, powerful shoulders, snow on its back

name: Harfang
desc: a snowy owl with piercing golden eyes, white feathers flecked with black, talons spread

name: Élémentaire de glace
desc: an ice elemental made of jagged translucent blue crystals, a cold glowing core, frosty mist

name: Mammouth
desc: a woolly mammoth with huge curved tusks, shaggy brown fur, small eyes, icicles hanging from its trunk

name: Chamane du givre
desc: a frost shaman wearing a horned animal skull mask, fur cloak with beads and feathers, holding a staff topped with an ice crystal. Original character

name: Phoque des glaces
desc: a sleek ice seal with silvery spotted fur, big dark eyes, whiskers, frost crystals on its head

name: Bouquetin
desc: a sturdy mountain ibex with long ridged curved horns, sure-footed stance, thick tawny coat

name: Esprit du blizzard
desc: a blizzard spirit, a swirling snowstorm forming a ghostly face with icy eyes, snowflakes spiraling

name: Grand Bouquetin
desc: a gigantic ancient ibex king with enormous spiraling horns carved with runes, majestic beard, standing on a mountain crag

name: Léviathan de glace
desc: an ice leviathan, a colossal serpent sea beast breaking through frozen water, icy scales, frosty breath, glowing eyes

name: Roi-Loup
desc: the Wolf King, an enormous grey-white wolf wearing a crown of ice, scarred eye, majestic mane, northern lights behind

name: Golem de cristal
desc: a huge crystal golem made of glowing blue and violet crystals, faceted body, radiant core in its chest

name: Grande Chamane
desc: a great frost shamaness with a tall antlered headdress, glowing blue face paint, a staff of ice, spirit wolves of light around her. Original character

name: Titan des glaces
desc: a frost titan giant with a craggy icy beard, armor of glacier ice, eyes like blizzards, wind and snow swirling

name: Méduse astrale
desc: an astral jellyfish with a translucent bell full of tiny stars, long glowing trailing tentacles, cosmic colors

name: Kraken juvénile

name: Requin-lame
desc: a blade shark with a long sword-like snout, sleek steel-blue body, rows of sharp teeth, aggressive glare

name: Crabe d'airain
desc: a brass crab with a polished bronze metallic shell, oversized riveted claws, small eye stalks

name: Poisson-lanterne
desc: an anglerfish with a glowing orange lantern lure, huge jaw full of needle teeth, dark deep-sea skin

name: Pieuvre des songes
desc: a dream octopus with soft pastel lavender skin, sleepy hypnotic swirling eyes, tentacles trailing dreamy bubbles

name: Nautile
desc: a nautilus in a striped spiral shell, tentacles peeking out, a curious eye, ancient fossil look

name: Corail vivant
desc: a living coral creature with branching red-orange coral body, tiny glowing polyp eyes, small fish around it

name: Étoile filante
desc: a living shooting star, a bright star creature with a little face and a long glittering comet tail

name: Astronome noyé
desc: a drowned astronomer ghost with a brass telescope, star-chart robes soaked and floating, glowing eyes, bubbles rising

name: Baleine lunaire
desc: a vast moon whale with silvery skin covered in crater patterns, a crescent moon glow on its head, swimming among stars

name: Reine-Corail
desc: a coral queen, a regal sea sorceress with a crown of branching red coral, flowing hair like anemones, pearl jewellery. Original character

name: Kraken ancien
desc: an ancient giant kraken with enormous barnacled tentacles, one huge glowing eye, dark abyssal colors

name: Prince des marées
desc: the Prince of Tides, a merfolk prince with a trident, crown of shells, flowing sea-green hair, swirling water around him. Original character

name: Gardien stellaire
desc: a stellar guardian, a tall armored celestial knight whose helmet is filled with a starry nebula, holding a shield shaped like a constellation

name: Dévoreur d'étoiles
desc: the Star Devourer, a cosmic void beast with a gaping maw full of swirling galaxies, many glowing eyes, tendrils of dark matter

name: cls_lame
desc: a nimble young duelist swordswoman with a light rapier, short wild hair, determined grin, leather and steel armor, earthy and water accents

name: cls_archere
desc: a sharp-eyed archer woman drawing a longbow with a fire-tipped arrow, hooded green-and-amber cloak, braided hair

name: cls_rempart
desc: a stalwart shield guardian in heavy plate armor with a large tower shield emblazoned with a simple cross, kind but stern face, short beard

name: cls_soigneuse
desc: a singing healer with a lute-like harp, flowing robes in warm tones, gentle smile, soft healing light notes around her

name: cls_chrono
desc: a chronomancer mage with an hourglass amulet, robes covered in clock gears, floating clock hands circling him, calm focused eyes

name: cls_artificier
desc: a goggled bomb-making tinkerer with soot on his face, bandolier of small round bombs, grinning, lit fuse sparks

name: cls_assassin
desc: a stealthy trap-setting assassin with a dark hood and mask, twin daggers, sharp eyes, a coiled snare at her belt

name: cls_flambeur
desc: a lucky gambler adventurer with a rakish hat, playing cards and dice spinning in the air, a confident smirk, flashy coat

name: cls_lancier
desc: a spear-wielding lancer knight with a long spear and pennant, crested helmet under his arm, determined look

name: cls_traqueur
desc: a feral beast tracker hunter with a wolf pelt hood, tribal paint, a curved blade, keen predatory eyes

name: cls_passeuse
desc: a mystic rift-walker sorceress opening a glowing portal with her hand, ornate circular sigils floating, flowing dark-red robes
